body:
Ruling: batch #365 item 5 · letter A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-18T13:50Z

Director seat, summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`, on the director's own card (A recommended), filed on the maintainer's words 「决裁 24298 AI 副驾 如果保存的是草稿的话，实际上不只是设计器，界面上也显示不出来。所以这个问题要综合评估。」 (opening marker objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708, comment 6247058702). The maintainer's words in this session's chat: 「同意」 on batch #365 items 2–5, confirmed after the seat's question 「是四张都按席位推荐吗？」.

**What the ruling binds (letter A — preview-first: every draft is one click from being seen; publish stays the human gate):**
1. The model stands: ADR-0033 (AI drafts, a human publishes), ADR-0037 (the draft-overlay preview for builders), ADR-0045 (additive whole-app builds publish behind `_unpublished`). Members see nothing of a draft until publish. No auto-publish of incremental edits.
2. The chat's Preview button appears for any draft, not only when the draft set includes an app, and deep-links to the affected page or object in `?preview=draft`, with the DraftPreviewBar naming what is pending — objectstack-ai/objectui#12968, p2 `pm:queue`.
3. Studio marks a copilot draft per key — objectstack-ai/objectstack#24298 resumes as filed and triaged (the spec key on the draft read; the engine writer; cloud's `copilot` stamp; Studio's 草稿 chip and 来源 line, objectui#12725 item 3); the hold (6249880263) is lifted by this letter; the `domain:spec#2` seat re-queues and dispatches it.
4. Known limit, recorded: a draft field or object has no storage, so a preview shows metadata, not data; seeing a change with data means publishing. If that limit is the maintainer's next pull, the letter is B (additive incremental edits auto-published behind lint, with the ADR-0045 amendment), filed then as its own card.

Not taken: B (publishes additive edits to members at once; parked on this record), C (a sticky default adds nothing the Preview button does not), D (a capability build; the Free plan has no development environment).

**Workload of the letter:** objectui S (Preview for any draft) + the #24298 chain as graded (spec S, engine S, cloud S, objectui S).

**Execution:** objectui#12968 filed in this act; pointer on #24298 (hold lifted); this card leaves `needs-user-decision` and closes `completed`.

Closed `completed` · ruled A at 6250704607 (batch #365 item 5, the maintainer's 「同意」) · director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) · 2026-10-18T13:52Z

Preview-first: objectstack-ai/objectui#12968 (the chat's Preview for any draft, p2 `pm:queue`); #24298 resumes as filed (pointer 6250719920). B (auto-publish additive incremental edits) stays on this record as the letter for the data limit, should the maintainer's next pull be 「带数据看到」.
